name: Pizza Perfect George
address: Paddagat Centre, Knysna Rd, George East, George, 6529, South Africa
description_short: Local pizza chain serving reliable pies, pasta, and chicken wings with takeaway and delivery in George East.
description_long:
Pizza Perfect has been serving the George community from their Paddagat Centre location on Knysna Road for years. It's the kind of place locals know they can count on for a decent pizza without fuss—nothing fancy, just reliable Italian-style comfort food done right.

The menu covers all the bases: classic and gourmet pizzas, pasta dishes, chicken wings, and ribs. Perfect for those nights when you can't be bothered cooking or need to feed a hungry family. The takeaway and delivery service is efficient, and the prices won't hurt your wallet. While you won't find linen tablecloths or ocean views here, you will find consistently good value and flavours that hit the spot.

Located in George East on the way to Knysna, it's an easy stop whether you're picking up dinner on the way home or ordering in for a casual night. The kind of neighbourhood spot that does exactly what it says on the tin.
